### Phase 8.3: anchor-and-sketch target-rate search

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase8-3-anchor-sketch/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Add a feature-gated structural anchor and context-aware RateSketch search with exact finalist replanning and exhaustive fallback. Normal-path budgets are at most two structural builds, two Full entropy searches, four exact candidates, and one final Store. Promotion requires target adherence, fallback <=5%, no per-cell SSIMULACRA2 regression beyond 0.25, and non-regressing corpus mean.

### Phase 8.4: finalist-only entropy and shared token tape

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase8-4-finalist-token-tape/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Confine entropy alternatives to one or two finalists and share a typed per-section token tape between training and exact Count/Store. Compare Store-every-finalist with Count-then-Store-one; require a 3% end-to-end win before changing policy.

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase8-5-leaf-finishing/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`
